title: OPS-BUGFIX — gate urgency off-by-one: 2/30 shows ON_TRACK instead of WARNING
description: With 28 posts left in 14 days, getUrgencyLevel() returns ON_TRACK because postsLeft > daysLeft*2 is 28>28=false. Fix: change > to >= so 2 posts/day needed shows WARNING, not ON_TRACK. Regenerate gate. Also update update-gate-tracker.ts and generate-gate-report.ts with same fix.
